title: squalify must report each file's header-unit convention
lead: Each field gets `nameParts {base, unit, convention}`. The file gets `layout.headerConvention {dominant, share, counts}` and the `headerConvention` hint, both with evidence.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** user-supplied unit tables; normalizing or converting units.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decision (2026-10-13): units appear in many custom forms, such as `I_Total(A)`, `VCC(V)`, `VCC_V` and `ICC_A`, and the descriptor should say which convention a file uses. Unit text from a units row is a value, so it is opt-in. Unit text parsed from header names comes from the header, which is always included.

The conventions mirror DataBall's `HeaderParser` patterns and its unit table (`DataBall/src/DataBall/HeaderParser.cs:12-89`, `Config.cs:108-122`), including its rule that a `_unit` suffix needs a known unit. That lets a consumer map conventions directly.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/squalify/Units/UnitTable.cs`: a fixed table with version 1. `limits.unitTable` records the version.
  - Base units: V, A, W, Hz, s, Ohm/ohm/Ω, F, H, dB, dBm, dBc, %, C/degC/°C, K.
  - SI prefixes f, p, n, u/µ, m, k, M and G apply to V, A, W, Hz, s, Ohm, F and H.
  - Matching is case-sensitive, apart from a documented alias list (for example `ohm`, `degC`).
- `src/squalify/Units/HeaderConventionParser.cs`: tries `nameParenUnit`, then `nameBracketUnit`, then `nameUnderscoreUnit` (splitting at the last `_` and checking the suffix against the table), then `none`. If the file has a units row, `unitsRow` applies to the fields that have no unit in their name.
- `FieldProfile.nameParts` is always included. `fields[].unit` from a units row is values tier.
- The `layout` fingerprint adds the dominant convention name. Full header names stay in the projection.
- `docs/design.md` "Header-unit conventions"; `docs/descriptor.md`; `docs/how-it-works.md` section 8.

sections.heading: Failing tests
Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement the table, then the parser, then the wiring.
3. Mutation check: drop the known-unit check for underscore, and `I_Total` must flip, turning test 1 red.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-14` on branch `sq-14`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-14: header-unit conventions` when the owner approves.
